# create_channel()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.create_channel`

## Signature

```python
async def create_channel(title: str, description: str = '') -> 'types.Chat': ...
```

## Documentation

Create a new broadcast channel.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`title`** (`str`)
  The channel title.

- **`description`** (`str`, *optional*)
  The channel description.

### Returns

[`Chat`](../../types/user_and_chats/Chat.md): On success, a chat object is returned.

### Example

```python
await app.create_channel("Channel Title", "Channel Description")
```
